title: HOW did 400,000 tons of solid mountain rock vanish without leaving a single trace? #Shorts
description:
HOW did 400,000 tons of solid mountain rock vanish without leaving a single trace?

Mainstream claims rock was discarded down talus slopes; however, no equivalent massive basalt debris mounds exist around Ellora. Ancient texts mention no aggregate dumps. Theorists claim vaporization; actual forensics show debris was pulverized and used in local Rashtrakuta bunds and Devagiri fort foundations.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
